<thought>Carbon‑13 NMR shows no signals in the typical carbonyl region (≈190‑220 ppm); all peaks are ≤ 140 ppm. This strongly indicates the absence of carbonyl carbons. To confirm, an IR spectrum would reveal a C=O stretch near 1700 cm⁻¹ if a carbonyl were present, but the NMR evidence is sufficient. Therefore the molecule contains zero carbonyl groups.</thought>
